# loading Libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(sjmisc)
library(summarytools)
```


# import file

```{r}
mnp<-read.csv("mnpulate.csv")
head(mnp)
```

### Task 1
#### filter cars to isolate  wheelbase >110

```{r}
wheel_filter<-mnp %>% 
  filter(Wheelbase<110)
head(wheel_filter)
```


## filter to include cars only of type sedan- USA 
## filter origin
```{r}
originmnf<-mnp %>% 
   filter(Origin=="USA")
head(originmnf)
```
## filter type
```{r}
typec<-originmnf %>% 
  filter(Type=="Sedan")
head(typec)
```





### Task 2
# Selection of columns
# continous columns
```{r}
sel_cont<-mnp %>% 
  select(Wheelbase, Length, Width, Weight )
head(sel_cont)
```
# categorical columns

```{r}
sel_des<-mnp %>% 
  select(Model, Origin, Type, Manufacturer )
head(sel_des)
```



## task 3:
# Creation or modification of variables
```{r}
create <- mnp %>% 
  mutate(weight_to_horsepower = Weight / Horsepower)

head(create)
```






# size class
```{r}
size_class<-mnp %>%
  mutate(sized_class=ifelse(Wheelbase<105,"Compact",ifelse(Wheelbase<=110,"Midsize","Large")))
head(size_class)
```




# task 4:
# continous descending
```{r}
horse_desc<-mnp %>% 
  arrange(desc(Horsepower))
head(horse_desc)

```
# ascending order to mpg.city
```{r}
mpg_asc<-horse_desc %>% 
  arrange(MPG.city)
head(mpg_asc)
```

# sort cars by A-Z
```{r}
a_z_sort<-mnp %>% 
 
group_by(Type) %>% 
          arrange(Manufacturer)

  
head(a_z_sort)
```
# SORTING BY TYPE NOW
```{r}
sort_by_type<-a_z_sort %>% 
group_by(Type) %>% 
arrange(Manufacturer)
          

print(sort_by_type)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(mnp))
```

# task 5:
# compute summary statistics 
# mean, median,  and standard deviation for continous variables
# data checking for missing values
```{r}
mv<-sum(is.na(mnp))
mv # NO MISSING VALUES
```
# CHECKING OUTLIERS 0n horsepower
```{r}
boxplot(mnp$Horsepower, main="check outliers")# No outliers

```

# perfoming mean, median and sd to horsepower

```{r}
mean_value<-mean(mnp$Horsepower, na.rm=TRUE)
median_value <-median(mnp$Horsepower, na.rm=TRUE)
variance_value <-var(mnp$Horsepower, na.rm=TRUE)
sd_value <-sd(mnp$Horsepower, na.rm=TRUE)
print(paste("mean:", mean_value ))
print(paste("median:", median_value ))
print(paste("variance:", variance_value ))
print(paste("standard deviation:", sd_value ))
```






# CHECKING OUTLIERS on price
```{r}
boxplot(mnp$Price, main="check outliers")# No outliers

```

# perfoming mean, median and sd to price

```{r}
mean_value<-mean(mnp$Price, na.rm=TRUE)
median_value <-median(mnp$Price, na.rm=TRUE)
variance_value <-var(mnp$Price, na.rm=TRUE)
sd_value <-sd(mnp$Price, na.rm=TRUE)
print(paste("mean:", mean_value ))
print(paste("median:", median_value ))
print(paste("variance:", variance_value ))
print(paste("standard deviation:", sd_value ))
```

# summary statistics  of horsepower and price

```{r}
sam_tab<-mnp %>% 
group_by(Type) %>% 
summarise(count=n(),
mean_power=mean(Horsepower),
median_power=median(Horsepower),
std_dv_power=sd(Horsepower),
mean_price=mean(Price),
median_price=median(Price),
std_dv_price=sd(Price))
print(sam_tab)

```




# group data by categories
## summary statistics  of type

```{r}
sam_tab<-mnp %>% 
group_by(Type) %>% 
summarise(count=n(),
mean_price=mean(Price),
mean_mileage=median(MPG.city),
)
print(sam_tab)

```
